configuration.customScripts:
<style>
#config-filter {
  width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: .45em .6em; margin-bottom: .8em;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--background, #fff); color: currentColor; font: inherit;
}
.config-no-match { display: block; font-style: italic; opacity: .8; margin-top: .5em; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var section = document.querySelector('#_global_configuration .sectionbody');
  if (!section || document.getElementById('config-filter')) { return; }
  var input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'search';
  input.id = 'config-filter';
  input.placeholder = 'Type to filter the options below by key, for example provider, mcp or contextWindow.';
  input.autocomplete = 'off';
  section.insertBefore(input, section.firstChild);
  var polish = function (s) { return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9.]+/g, ''); };
  var apply = function () {
    var q = polish(input.value);
    document.querySelectorAll('.config-list dl').forEach(function (dl) {
      var visible = 0;
      var noMatch = dl.querySelector('.config-no-match');
      dl.querySelectorAll('dt.hdlist1').forEach(function (dt) {
        var dd = dt.nextElementSibling;
        var show = !q || polish(dt.textContent).indexOf(q) !== -1;
        dt.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
        if (dd && dd.tagName === 'DD') { dd.style.display = show ? '' : 'none'; }
        if (show) { visible++; }
      });
      if (visible === 0) {
        if (!noMatch) {
          noMatch = document.createElement('p');
          noMatch.className = 'config-no-match';
          noMatch.textContent = 'No option matches the filter.';
          dl.appendChild(noMatch);
        }
        noMatch.style.display = '';
      } else if (noMatch) {
        noMatch.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });
  };
  input.addEventListener('input', apply);
})();
</script>
